items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Ma Rainey, she used to sing in Tent Shoes. Right here at Tyler Allen and Threat.

ctx.x: Well let me ask you about some of the singers in general now since you can't hear that name. Do you remember Ma Rainey and-
Ma Rainey, that's who I was trying to call them. Ma Rainey, she used to sing in Tent Shoes. Right here at Tyler Allen and Threat.
